answer: A bonded-stake gate makes Sybil cost-proportional, not account-proportional. Every identity must lock slashable collateral before it can attest or claim rewards. A vine of free wallets has zero weight; to gain any, the attacker must fund each clone from scarce capital, so a thousand puppets behave like one account and get clustered. Honest operators pay the same barrier cheaply, since their collateral is recoverable. A fake harbor of clones pays full lockup per head, and the shale of dead wallets yields nothing.
